name: Maro no Kanja wa Gatenkei
original_name: 麻呂の患者はガテン系
source: Hikomaro works as a doctor. He is also a pervert. One day, Sakimi came to his doctor's office asking about a small pain. Over time he gained her trust and began giving her advice about marriage life, specially about making children. Being the pervert he is he takes advantage of her trust and begins sexually caressing several parts of her body during examinations...
translation: 麻吕是一名医生，同时也是个变态。某天，咲美来到他的诊所询问一个小毛病。随着时间推移，他获得了她的信任，并开始为她提供婚姻生活的建议，尤其是关于生孩子的事。他本性难移，利用她的信任在检查过程中对她的身体各处进行猥亵……
